sources.reason: About 25 frames in candump's console format, truncated by the poster ('lots of 080'); no PDO mapping is shown, so its PDOs cannot be interpreted. It adds nothing the Copley logs do not show except a boot-up message and NMT reset communication, both covered by unit tests.

cases.checks: 0x1018 uploads give vendor 0xAB and the product, revision and serial numbers

every request is answered on the same node and object with the matching command; the client sends the recorded requests byte for byte and accepts the answers; the server answers the recorded requests as the drive did
cases.dynamicFields: values are device state: before each upload the server's object holds the value the drive answered; bytes after the indicated size of an expedited answer are undefined (CiA 301) and not compared (the drives leave stale bytes there)

cases.checks: TPDO5 on COB-ID 0x180 maps 0x1013 (high-resolution time stamp, microseconds); frames on it decode as that TPDO after the configuration is seen, not before
every RTR on 0x700+node is answered with the state and an alternating toggle bit (first answer 0x85); guard time 200 ms, life time factor 3; life guarding error 0x8130 600 ms after the last request
error reset after NMT start; 0x8130 and 0x61FF with register 0x81
statusword from TPDO1 with the mapping read over SDO; fault reset is transition 15; Enable operation in Switch on disabled goes to Operation enabled (no CiA 402 transition: vendor behaviour)
the EDS validates without errors and every object the logs read or write is in it with a matching access type and size
34 frames decode with the counts of each kind Wireshark shows; 10 aborts
